summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its 1Q26 earnings release. The report discloses record net income of S/2,063 million (up 16.1% YoY), a 21.1% ROE, loan growth of 8.2% YoY, and an improved NPL ratio of 4.3%. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation filing. No terms such as price per share, premium, or board recommendation are present. The filing is simply a financial results update with no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other transformative event. What to watch: There is no risk-arb angle as this is purely an operational update.
